summary.text: Ed Soliday is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 4, assumed office in 2006, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists Ryan Kominakis (D) and Travis Gearhart (L) as the other candidates on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Soliday as Edmond Soliday; his professional experience includes working as an adjunct professor at George Washington University, an aviation safety consultant, and a vice president, director, manager and pilot with United Airlines.
For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists Soliday as chair of the Utilities, Energy and Telecommunications Committee and a member of the Roads and Transportation Committee.
